#### Peaty and smooth and approachable

This scotch is a nice combination of peaty, sweetness, a bit of malty funk but quite smooth for a single malt. I feel like in the whiskey world (and beer world), smoothness is looked down upon nowadays. People want the most flavorful overpowering drink they can get, and anything that drinks smooth is considered ‘flat’ or boring.

#### Worth every penny - now my favourite

Was recommended by a staff member in Phoenix after I described what I was looking for and it hit the nail on the head. I’d been stuck in the Speysides, and I wanted to up the peat and smoke, but didn’t want to suck on a bog with one of the heavier Islay ones like Laphroaig. This is now my favourite scotch; it has exactly what I love is a scotch - great balance, medium peat and slightly stronger smoke with a very smooth honey finish. It also has a surprising chocolate punch midway.

#### Superb flavor

I'm a huge fan of peated and heavily peated single malts. My first taste was at Yukon Brewing in Whitehorse, Yukon, Canada.

Since then I've tried several, and this one definitely holds up to many of the other much higher priced single malts. It has the smoky scent and flavor, silky smooth texture, and overall leaves me wanting more.

Surprised and pleased, I'll buy it again.
